subject: Pipeline to Fleet bridge: sprint capacity ask and deal breakout
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Walsh <erin@cloudwave.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline to Fleet bridge: sprint capacity ask and deal breakout

Team — looping you in for this week's cross-functional fleet planning sync. Attached is the latest pipeline snapshot (pipeline_snapshot_mar12.csv) with expected start dates and probability bands. Key asks:  

- Can infra provide an initial slot-hours estimate per active deal (Committed / Probable / Upside) for the next 90 days? Please include preferred allocation (dedicated slots vs. burst).
- Finance: flag any deals that require prepayment / PO gating to enable dedicated capacity.
- Sales ops: recommend a staged allocation (canary -> scale) for deals showing pilot start dates in Apr/May.

High priority: Nimbus pilot (DEAL-4983) is showing a firm POC start 2029-04-01 with expected token-heavy inference (low latency interactive). Erin from Nimbus is cc'd — we want to avoid last-minute slot requests.

Can everyone reply with a short estimate and one recommended action by EOD Wednesday (2029-03-13)? We'll use these inputs in Friday's fleet-ops huddle.

Attachments: pipeline_snapshot_mar12.csv

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Walsh <erin@cloudwave.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline to Fleet bridge: sprint capacity ask and deal breakout

Ben / team — quick infra read and initial sizing attached (benchtable_gpu_plan_v1.xlsx). High-level notes: 

- Nimbus (DEAL-4983): recommended start allocation = 120 vGPU slots (equivalent to 240 RTX-8000 half-slot bursts) for first 30 days as a canary, then ramp to 200 slots if latency and token throughput are within SLOs. This assumes model runs quantized int8 and we enable prefix KV caching for session reuse.
- Conservative vs. aggressive profiles: conservative = reserve 60 slots + 40 burst credits; aggressive = reserve 160 slots (higher commit cost) but lower risk of throttling during POC. I've included a per-deal sheet with slot-hours/week estimates by probability band.
- Constraints: current dedicated pool for APR-May has ~320 slots available for new reserves before we hit procurement lead times (6-8 weeks for additional GPU capacity). If Nimbus converts mid-April we will need to either shift burst credits from lower-priority deals or secure a short-term dedicated tranche.

Attachment: benchtable_gpu_plan_v1.xlsx (sheets: summary, per_deal_est, risk_matrix)

I'll be on the Friday ops call to walk the plan. If Finance needs rough $ numbers to approve PO, Jordan ping me and I'll provide slot-hour to $ conversion for the two profiles.

- Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Mar 2029 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline to Fleet bridge: sprint capacity ask and deal breakout

Thanks, Ben & Vivek — finance read below.

- High level: we can fund short-term burst credits for Nimbus POC (DEAL-4983) up to ~$18k for APR if they sign a PO for the pilot. For any dedicated reserve longer than 60 days we need a signed commitment (PO or prepay) covering the committed slot monthly run-rate.
- For Nimbus specifically: their AE told us they can commit to a 3-month pilot with an upfront partial invoice. If legal/contract terms look standard we can expedite to get a PO processed in ~5 business days. I've attached a draft term sheet (commit_terms_draft.pdf).
- Sensitivity: if we allocate aggressive reserved slots (160+), that will require a >$45k monthly commitment — need approval from Rev Ops and a signed DocuSign. Otherwise we recommend conservative reserve + burst strategy.

Action items for our side:
1) Ben — confirm Nimbus's appetite for partial prepay so we can seed a dedicated tranche.
2) Vivek — provide $/slot-hour conversion for both conservative and aggressive profiles (you mentioned you could).
3) Laura — can you publish a prioritized list of deals that would be candidate donors for burst credit reallocation?

Attachment: commit_terms_draft.pdf

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Finance Lead, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Walsh <erin@cloudwave.ai>, Nimbus Corp <partnerships@nimbus.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Mar 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline to Fleet bridge: sprint capacity ask and deal breakout — action items

Thanks for the inputs — consolidating next steps so we have a single source of truth before Friday's ops call: 

1) Nimbus (DEAL-4983) allocation (tentative):
   - Canary (Apr 1 start): reserve 120 vGPU slots for 30 days, then evaluate telemetry for scale to 200 slots.
   - Buffer: hold 20 burst-eligible slots as a safety net during the canary window.
2) Finance gating: Jordan to draft a partial prepay invoice (using commit_terms_draft.pdf) and circulate DocuSign link to Nimbus AE. Ben to confirm their willingness to prepay.
3) Infra deliverables: Vivek to provide $/slot-hour numbers and a 2-profile cost table (conservative / aggressive) by EOD Thu so Finance has final figures for PO authoring.
4) Sales ops: I will publish a donor-list of deals we can shift burst credits from; priority donors will be low-probability deals in Apr. Expect the donor-list in the shared Drive folder by 2029-03-15 morning.
5) Ops call: we'll present this plan on Friday (2029-03-16) at 10:30 PT. Vivek — please bring the benchtable slides and a short runbook for slot rollback if the canary shows issues.

Attachments: fleet_action_items.md (bulletized action list and timelines)

Erin / Nimbus — appreciate the heads-up on the pilot start date. Ben will follow up for the prepay confirmation and Jordan will send the DocuSign.

Laura Bennett
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
